input.quote: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Client is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system, design, formula, procedure or trade secret to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink hereunder
input.rationale: No clause imposes exclusivity or sole-supplier status on Client. The licence in § 2(a) is expressly non-exclusive and § 2(a) affirmatively preserves Client's freedom to acquire, develop or license competing software and services, so the rule's preferred position is met. The only sourcing-flavoured term is § 3(i) ("Client shall order TrueLink a credit report on each borrower for which an underwriting approval is requested through a System using the Interface"), which bites only where Client voluntarily uses TrueLink's Interface and is coupled with the express freedom to use alternatives; under the playbook's boundary that is not an exclusivity obligation. The "Non-Competition Agreement" referenced in § 8(d) limits TrueLink's use of Credit Data and any exclusivity there runs in Client's favour, which is acceptable. Nothing to redline.
